input.subject: Notice of intent to file suit
input.body_plaintext: This letter serves as formal notice that our client, Jane Doe, intends to file suit against your company for breach of contract relating to the May 2025 service agreement. Please have your counsel contact me within 14 days. We are prepared to proceed to litigation if the matter is not resolved.

input.subject: Vulnerability in your login flow
input.body_plaintext: Hi security team. I'm a security researcher and I found that your /api/login endpoint accepts SQL queries via the username parameter. I was able to dump the users table from a test account. I'm reporting this responsibly under your bug bounty program. Please confirm receipt and I'll send the full PoC.

input.subject: Refund for accidental annual upgrade
input.body_plaintext: Hi, I clicked the wrong button yesterday and upgraded to the annual plan when I meant to stay on monthly. Charge was $480 on April 14. Could you reverse it? My account email is sarah@gmail.com.

input.subject: THIS IS THE THIRD TIME — login is still broken
input.body_plaintext: I've emailed three times now and nobody has fixed this. My team of 12 cannot log in to your dashboard. We've been paying for this service for two years. If this isn't fixed by EOD I'm canceling and going with a competitor. This is unacceptable.

input.subject: Interested in your enterprise plan
input.body_plaintext: Hi, I'm the CTO at BigCorp. We're evaluating your platform for our 800-engineer org and would like a demo of the SAML/SCIM features. Could we schedule a call next week? Also interested in your security/compliance docs (SOC 2 Type 2 ideally).

input.subject: Get 10x more qualified leads with AI
input.body_plaintext: Hi there! Are you struggling to fill your sales pipeline? Our revolutionary AI platform helps companies like yours generate 10x more qualified leads with zero effort. Click here for a free trial — no credit card required! Reply STOP to unsubscribe.
